description.text: The Primordial Arts Deck Building Gift Box: Torrent (卡组构筑礼盒 洪荒演武 激) came out on 17 November 2023, with its Overgrow (茂) twin, for players who wanted to build their own deck around the new booster. It held one random Pokémon V holo, one of five made in equal numbers: Flapple V, Blaziken V, Ice Rider Calyrex V, Rapid Strike Urshifu V and Metagross V. With it came 17 useful Trainer cards, three Special Energy, 48 basic Energy (six of each of eight types), a random 25-card Torrent pack, a player's guide and a deck box. On Pokémon's Tmall store only members could buy it.
